task: Q3 mechanistic roles and region-composed accuracy prediction
scope: Development experiments on 1024 supplied 2^28-sequence networks; six zoo networks are additional diagnostics. No control variates, importance sampling, or target sampling estimator is used by the predictors.

units.accuracy: fraction unless key explicitly says pp, points or percent
units.contribution: probability of being in a region and being wrong
units.pp: percentage points, 100 times a probability difference
units.pp2: squared percentage points, 10000 times a probability-squared quantity

validation_scope: Fixed small model menus and fivefold splits with seeds 0 and 1729. Feature-design choices were developed on this archive; no pristine model-lineage confirmatory population is claimed.
authoritative_version_policy: Only comparator_core_results/cv/audit are authoritative for comparator interventions and coverage. Preliminary comparator gate, diagnostic and followup files are intentionally excluded. Designed predictions use corrected v3 probe geometry and audited derivative/optimized feature definitions.

comparator_core_results.probe_regions: S=.45 gives clean cases; S=.8 gives middle direct-second and max-near-tie handoff.

comparator_core_audit.note: Core supersedes preliminary gate features: ties resolved by output-scaled response amplitude, any exact remaining ties averaged; canonical extraction uses float64.

weight_taxonomy_overlap.note: All entries describe continuous overlaps; eta and correlation fractions are marginal rather than additive variance decompositions.

caveats: Classification predicts z3 rule labels, not independently verified causal roles.
Mixed role axes are dominant marginal variance fractions; state directions generally combine several functions.

designed_gbm_fixed_results.note: Fixed GBM diagnostic of nonlinear interactions; not itself a mechanistic explanation.
designed_gbm_fixed_results.clipping: Predetermined componentwise [0, supplied empirical region mass].

zoo_reference.note: Independent IID Gaussian reference only; no target prediction uses these outcomes.

readout_phase_counterexample.explanation: All z2 neuron features remain exactly unchanged in real arithmetic after cyclically rotating Wo rows. Rates, thresholds and final hidden states are untouched; readout column norms and DFT magnitudes are invariant. Readout phase/slot alignment is essential.

single_target_timing.note: Current extractor always computes all neuron, reverse-gradient, tangent-radius and aggregated features. No role-only timing shortcut was implemented. Prediction time is additional.

designed_features_fast_audit.networks: First16 population members plus all6 zoo models
designed_features_fast_audit.changes: Cached input-only probe metadata/pseudoinverse; batched matmul; vectorized reductions and exact linear10th-percentile formula. Same feature definitions and output order.

single_target_timing.note: Warm input-only caches; includes all features; inputs resident; excludes regressor inference. Call ordering alternates each repetition.

forward_timing.setup: Weights and inputs resident; times exclude input generation and include function/Python overhead.

ridge_catalog.caveat: Ungated linear impulse and eigenmodes are candidate paths, not actual ReLU event selectivity.

additive_catalog.caveat: Ungated linear impulse and eigenmodes are candidate paths, not actual ReLU event selectivity.

gbm_diagnostic.note: GBM is a diagnostic nonlinear predictor, not the mechanistic explanation

residual_analysis.definition: e_j=clipped predicted region contribution minus supplied observed contribution; S=mean(e e^T). Overall MSE=sum of all S entries. Allocation to region j=sum_k S_jk, splitting each unordered cross term equally. This is a second-moment decomposition, not merely covariance, and includes bias.

population_scale_and_target.equivalent_IID_scope: p_mean*(1-p_mean)/RMSE^2 compares MSE to a Bernoulli sample mean at representative accuracy p_mean. It is not a measured speedup, not an interval guarantee, and does not make biased prediction unbiased.

paired_bootstrap_development_diagnostics.kind: Paired network-row bootstrap of frozen OOF errors
paired_bootstrap_development_diagnostics.scope: Conditional development diagnostic only; not a formal confidence-coverage claim. Network rows are resampled jointly across models. Existing folds, fitted models, feature design and shared reference pool are held fixed. Training-set variability, meta-selection and shared input-pool uncertainty are not regenerated.
paired_bootstrap_development_diagnostics.baseline: weight64_gbm with the same predetermined region clipping

central_findings.goal_status: Useful mechanistic descriptions and modest cross-network prediction are demonstrated; 0.3 percentage-point RMSE is not reached and no total-compute gain is demonstrated.

pure_threshold_coverage_is_not_an_exact_.status: Refuted on constructed clean diagnostic cases; this does not refute every possible richer coverage definition.

comparators_have_a_causal_handoff_role.intervention: Swap only comparator coordinates between matched new-second and new-max states.
comparators_have_a_causal_handoff_role.scope: Constructed matched state interventions; not a claim that comparator count alone determines clean-region error.

central_findings.roles_are_overlapping_and_some_are_subsp: Always-on and other mix value and age coding. Write selectivity, stored trajectory, handoff, and decoder rejection are distinct checks. Full ungated eigenmodes alone did not separate the mixed classes.

fixed_region_matched_hybrid_ridge.role: Portable calibrated linear predictor of region contributions; an empirical response calibration, not a derived analytic error formula.

combined_fixed_GBM_diagnostic.role: Fixed nonlinear diagnostic of interactions; not a mechanistic explanation or a proved ceiling.

completed_small_fixture.purpose: CLI fitting/export check only; fixture scores are not study results.

audit.tests_scope: Existing 16-model fitting fixture, saved prediction reloads, cache parity, and requested report-only pulse/role checks. No further model selection.
